items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Buchanan called us over and just ate us out. And he was thinking about letting us go... 'You get back on that stand and don't you come off'

ctx.x: Trying to find that beat. And we stayed in one tempo, all night long. And when we finally got intermission, Buchanan called us over and just ate us out. And he was thinking about letting us go, but he said, 'You get back on that stand and don't you come off, till it's time to close.' And we had to play all the way through when we got there. And we played and they started jumping. Kept that same tempo. But we outswung everything that was up there that day.
